answer: Make every identity earn standing through a continuous-activity clock, like water wearing a karst cave: a new agent's beacon only glows after 90 epochs of steady, verifiable activity. Go silent for a full epoch and the clock resets to zero; a caught fake resets every identity sharing its sponsor link. Forging 1,000 identities means running 1,000 clocks for 90 epochs each — 540,000 agent-hours — while an honest agent pays that time once. A tide of fakes cannot skip the wait. Limitation: honest agents who go offline for real reasons lose their standing too.
